repos.name: polis
repos.relevance: Sprint 7 sensemaking — cosine similarity clustering, PCA projection, bridging statement detection, real-time opinion visualization

repos.name: arweave
repos.relevance: Archival problem survey — blockweave structure, succinct random proofs, the storage-endowment funding model (one-time fee underwrites perpetual replication). DDS-WG identified as cold-path archival; investigate as informative comparison and possible doorway-projected archival target.

repos.name: filecoin
repos.relevance: Archival problem survey — incentivized IPFS, market-based storage deals, proof-of-spacetime, proof-of-replication. Closest CID/IPLD overlap with our content-addressing stack; potential interop target via doorway projection rather than divergence point.

repos.name: logos
repos.relevance: Archival problem survey — entry point to the Status-incubated sovereign-network stack (Waku messaging, Codex storage, Nomos consensus). Closest peer to Elohim's full-stack civil-society framing; worth cloning the docs hub first before drilling into sub-protocol repos (waku-org, codex-storage, nomos-research).

repos.name: social-distributed-press
repos.relevance: Edge Problem / doorway federation — Hypha Co-op's Social Inbox: a minimal ActivityPub server that splits AP into static-published actor/outbox/posts + a thin dynamic inbox (follows/replies/likes), HTTP-Signature auth over the site keypair, actor+instance allow/block moderation, and draft-FEP-1042 alias-bridging of P2P content into the fediverse. Closest external mirror of the doorway's projection+federation job; ActivityPub-flavor companion to the atproto-lexicon-projection-doorway spec (which defers AP generalization). See doorway/research/activitypub-federation-prior-art.md and genesis/research/hypha-distributed-press-cross-pollination-2026-06-23.md.

repos.name: hypercore
repos.relevance: Networking / Content-Addressing / p2p-dataplane prior art — secure single-writer append-only signed log (BLAKE2b merkle), SPARSE replication ('download only the blocks you need' = 'replication follows relationship'). Structurally a Holochain source chain but integrity-only (no shared validation): a candidate data-plane substrate beside iroh/libp2p, NEVER a truth layer. Autobase (in the holepunchto org) is multi-writer-convergence prior art vs Automerge. See steward/node/research/hypercore-holepunch-prior-art.md.

repos.name: hyperdht
repos.relevance: Networking prior art (p2p layer, NOT doorway/federation) — the DHT powering Hyperswarm: peer discovery by topic/discoveryKey (find peers without leaking the core key) with UDP HOLEPUNCHING as a first-class feature into Noise-encrypted streams. One of the most mature holepunching-first JS-ecosystem DHTs (deployed at scale via Holepunch/Keet); relevant to the live WAN-NAT gap and the tx5/go-pion lineage. Discovery-by-topic rhymes with affinity-weighted steward topology.

repos.name: civic-ai
repos.relevance: Peer project / conceptual prior-art — the civic.ai static site + the '6-Pack of Care' governance framework (Audrey Tang + Caroline Green, Oxford Institute for Ethics in AI; illustrations by Nicky Case; Astro/markdown, bilingual EN/zh-TW). The Eastern 'Kami of the Commons' approach to the same entity our elohim names, from a different ontology than our Judeo-Christian framing: bounded, inspectable, community-OWNED local AI stewards a community can correct and switch off (alignment-by-process; care as a daily capability; many small locally-governed systems vs one universal governor). NOTE: the repo is the framework + site, NOT runtime code — but the KAMI CONCEPT it articulates is exactly the light per-device agent-local-steward runtime the elohim architecture has DEFERRED (the eprfs / witnessed-interaction work). Deep-dive next for the governance framework + the concept mirror, not a codebase to port. Kindred aim, different lens. Contact: Audrey Tang (au@civic.ai) + Caroline Green.
